rows.national_remote_sensing_centre_isro_nrsc: Honorarium based on number of Prime beneficiaries attached ranging from Rs. 8,000 to Rs. 15,000.
MBBS with valid Permanent Medical Council Registration and minimum two years experience.

content_sections.heading: ISRO NRSC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. NRSC/CHSS/01/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ISRO NRSC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS with Valid Permanent Medical Council Registration and minimum two years' experience. Experience: Minimum two years of experience after valid Medical Council Registration. Other conditions: Candidate shall be a practicing medical doctor and have an established clinic at the location advertised. Clinic must be located near Autonagar Gate, Donka Road, Patamata, Vijayawada. A central location within one kilometer radius between Benz Circle and Ramavarapupadu centre shall be preferred. AMO should be available for medical treatment/consultation for minimum of 06 Hours from Monday to Saturday and on Sunday at least during Morning Hours. Only Indian Nationals need to apply. Desirable: Retired Govt. doctors are encouraged to apply.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for ISRO NRSC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates whose clinic is not located in the area advertised. Incomplete applications and applications with no attachment of application fee payment receipt.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Honorarium based on number of Prime Beneficiaries: Rs.8000 for 10-30, Rs.11000 for 31-50, Rs.15000 for 51-100. Initially 03 years and can be extended with mutual consent. Centre reserves the right to terminate the position at any time before completion of the tenure.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: As per procedure prescribed under Annexure-II.

content_sections.heading: How Will ISRO NRSC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Initial screening based on academic performance and other parameters. NRSC team visit to the clinic of shortlisted candidates to inspect facilities. Initial screening to shortlist candidates based on academic performance and parameters. Inspection of clinic facilities by NRSC team for shortlisted candidates.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form Legibly scanned copies of MBBS Degree Registration certificate by Medical Council Experience certificates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ISRO NRSC Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Forward the duly filled-in application form as prescribed in Annexure-I. Attach legibly scanned copies of MBBS Degree, Medical Council Registration certificate and experience certificates along with application fee payment receipt. Send the email to [email protected] with subject: Application for the purely contractual position of Authorized Medical Officer at Vijayawada. Send it on or before 15 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Hard copies will not be entertained during initial application submission. Hard copies of application and original certificates must be furnished during inspection. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
